description: July 5 birthday meaning: Cancer decan 2, birthday number 5, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a July 5 birthday falls in Cancer, in the second decan, with Moon as the sign's ruler and Pluto as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 5. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Cancer is cardinal and water.

sections.heading: July 5 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Early July's Cancer, thirteen degrees in, gets a restless partner in the number 5. The Crab likes a shell; five likes the open road. The Pluto decan adds intensity, so this birthday is often pictured as someone who changes deeply rather than often, with a few big reinventions over a lifetime instead of constant small adjustments.

On July 5 the Sun usually sits at about 13° Cancer, in the second decan, where Pluto is the sub-ruler alongside Moon. In the middle of Cancer, from 10 to 19 degrees, the sub-ruler is Pluto, the modern ruler of Scorpio. That brings an intensity to the Crab's tenderness. Early-July birthdays are often linked with emotional depth, loyalty that runs very deep, and a sharp instinct for what goes unsaid in a room. These Cancerians tend to protect privately and completely, sometimes keeping their own needs hidden behind the shell. Pluto adds resilience and a capacity for real renewal after loss. Learning to trust selectively, rather than all or nothing, usually helps the intensity become a source of steadiness instead of strain.

sections.heading: July 5 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 5th, your birthday number is 5, sitting at the exact midpoint of the single digits. Numerologists read the day of birth as a secondary note, a personal knack rather than a fixed fate. The 5 is linked with movement, the senses and curiosity, so a 5th birthday is traditionally associated with adaptability and a low tolerance for monotony. These people often learn fastest by doing and enjoy travel, variety and new company. Freedom matters to them, and so does choosing which commitments are worth the trade, since restlessness can otherwise scatter a great deal of energy.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one July 5 birthday to the next: it is 1 for 1960, 2 for 1970, 3 for 1980 and 4 for 1990, for example.

sections.heading: Born on July 5: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: July birthdays land in high summer north of the equator, with long warm evenings, and in midwinter in the southern hemisphere. Cancer holds the first three weeks, with Leo arriving around July 22 or 23. In numerology July is month 7, the number of reflection, analysis and inner life, which tends to give these birthdays a thoughtful, private layer beneath the summer brightness. July 5 is the 186th day of the year (187th in a leap year). By July 23, 18 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Leo.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by July 5, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on July 5 include Georges Pompidou (1911), Jean Cocteau (1889) and Cecil John Rhodes (1853).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is July 5?
faq.answer: July 5 is Cancer in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Cancer, which tradition links with Pluto.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on July 5?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On July 5 the Life Path is 1 in 1960, 2 in 1970, 3 in 1980, 4 in 1990, 5 in 2000, 6 in 2010 and 7 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 5 for everyone born on the 5th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on July 5?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a July 5 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on July 5?
faq.answer: July 5 is also the birthday of Georges Pompidou (1911), Jean Cocteau (1889) and Cecil John Rhodes (1853). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
